candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from span attributes only; no Postgres server-side metrics or logs confirm saturation versus a slow query holding connections.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeouts and postgres.save_order failures with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable, while inventory/payment succeed. This bounds the fault to the order-to-postgres path, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion. Logs were excluded, so server-side confirmation is still required.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active/idle connections, wait time, max_connections) to confirm pool saturation
Order service logs for pool acquisition timeouts or slow queries
Postgres slow-query or lock-wait evidence to rule out a slow query holding connections
